title: MWS — Anthropometric
description: Body measurements at recruitment, calculated from self-reported feet/inches or stones/pounds.

RHEIGHT.title: Height now
RHEIGHT.$comment: Source states valid range 120-200. Type number (not integer): a feet/inches-to-cm conversion can yield a fractional value -- agent-decided, D017.

RWGT.title: Weight now
RWGT.$comment: Source states valid range 35-150. Type number, same reasoning as RHEIGHT -- D017.

RBMI.title: Body mass index
RBMI.x-derivation: Calculated from RHEIGHT and RWGT (or their source components).
RBMI.$comment: Source states no valid range for this field. 10-80 is an agent-decided plausibility bound (rejects impossible BMI, e.g. negative or over 100) -- D018.

$comment: Soft checks: RBMI should approximately equal RWGT / (RHEIGHT/100)^2 when all three are substantive values. JSON Schema cannot verify cross-field arithmetic -- not enforced, see DECISIONS.md.
